newsitem.title: USA: Gap March same-store sales fall 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gap March same-store sales fall 3.0 pct.

text.p: Gap Inc Thursday reported sales of $524 million for the five-week period ended April 5, 1997, an increase of 11 percent over sales of $473 million for the comparable period ended April 6, 1996. Same-store sales fell 3.0 percent.
For the nine weeks ended April 5, Gap reported sales of $828 million, up 11 percent over sales of $743 million for the same period in 1996. Year to date same-store sales fell 2.0 percent.
As of April 5, Gap operated 1,895 stores compared with 1,705 at April 6, 1996, an increase of 11 percent.
